messages:
ana-partners: Quick kickoff: vendor wants listings across AWS/GCP/Azure. They've only done AWS so far, need Azure publisher created and GCP billing link. Can we list a minimal action list?

dave-cloud: Minimal ops list: create Azure Publisher account + MPN ID, provide Publisher ID; for GCP provide Billing Account ID and service-account key with roles: roles/storage.objectViewer, roles/pubsub.viewer (read-only). For AWS provide S3 artifact bucket + cross-account role.

kara-ops: Also need artifacts: container image digests (sha256), test manifests, and a short 1-line product blurb + 300-char description. We need a hero PNG (1200x628) and screenshots.

tom-legal: Legal must receive countersigned DPA, EULA text (marketplace variant), SOC2 cert PDF, and any logo release forms. Ask vendor to include a contact for legal escalation.

ana-partners: small correction: my handle is ana-partners :)

ana-partners: timeline ask: staging preview by next Wednesday, GA listing target in 4 weeks. Any blockers?

dave-cloud: Blockers: Azure publisher creation can take 48-72h for verification. GCP billing linkage needs admin on their billing account. We should request temporary staging credentials at least 5 days before preview.

kara-ops: For automation, please create an IAM role named "redwood_marketplace_ingest" on AWS with these permissions:```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::vendor-marketplace-artifacts/*"]}]}
```Also add a GCP service account key with limited scope; rotate after ingest.

tom-legal: Quick Q: do we expect vendor to accept Redwood's marketplace addendum or can we use their standard EULA?

dave-cloud: Prefer vendor EULA with our addendum appended. For Azure acceptability we often need our addendum included in offer metadata.

ana-partners: @azure-rep-bot can you loop in the Azure onboarding rep and create the ticket?

azure-rep-bot: Azure contact (jules@azure) added. Ticket: AZ-ONB-2026-089. Verification ETA: 3 business days. :white_check_mark:

kara-ops: For trial entitlements: propose two plans: trial-30d (Dev) and trial-14d (Enterprise eval). Provide mapping CSV: sku_id,plan_id,trial_days,entitlement_name. We'll need the vendor to confirm plan IDs in each cloud.

dave-cloud: Also ask vendor for a test endpoint (staging URL) that returns a 200 and a sample payload for smoke tests. If container, include digest and docker run sample.

tom-legal: I'll draft a one-page checklist that includes: DPA, EULA variant, SOC2, logo release, contact emails, and acceptance of addendum. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

ana-partners: I'll collect artifacts and share a single zip link when ready. Ping here once legal + ops items are in.

kara-ops: One more: include a small Azure offer manifest example in the checklist so vendor can map fields. E.g.:```xml
<PackageIdentifier>com.vendor.product</PackageIdentifier>
<Plan id="dev">
  <Name>Developer</Name>
</Plan>
```

dave-cloud: Good. If anything stalls, escalate to #partnerships-sig.

ana-partners: Thanks all  I'll send checklist + sample CSV in 15m and update this thread when vendor confirms publisher ID.
